name: PEEK
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A polysynth in the manner of the Novation Peak: three oscillators per voice (sine, triangle, saw, pulse with shape, VSync, saw density, 60 wavetables), linear FM between them, ring mod and noise, a state-variable LP/BP/HP filter (12/24 dB) between a fattening overdrive and a bright post drive, three looping envelopes, four LFOs, animate, a 16-slot modulation matrix and a 4-slot FX matrix, arp with 33 rhythms, distortion, chorus, delay and reverb. 8 or 16 voices, ECO and HIGH quality.
